name: tr_walter
caption:
IF WALTER WAS A POKÉMON TRAINER, THIS IS HIS TEAM 🎮🏀

🧸 Teddiursa, the bear cub: Big 12 Freshman of the Year at Baylor
🐟 Magikarp, the late bloomer: pick 19, hurt before camp, sent down to the 905
❄️ Froslass, ice in his veins: game-winning three with 0.5 seconds left in Orlando
🏹 Decidueye, the archer: 40.9% from three last season
🔥 Infernape, the big stage: playoff career-high 24 in an overtime win over Cleveland
🐉 Gyarados, the ace: fully evolved, 10.9 points a night through 9 games

Which one would you add? 👇

facts.claim: Walter played college basketball for the Baylor Bears and was named Big 12 Freshman of the Year (2024); June 26, 2024 selected with the 19th overall pick (#19, pick 19) by Toronto; missed training camp with an AC joint sprain and was assigned several times to Raptors 905; March 4, 2025: game-winning three (3) with 0.5 seconds remaining in a 114-113 win at Orlando; May 1, 2026: playoff career-high 24 points in a 112-110 overtime (OT) win against Cleveland
